result.title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
result.summary: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

AI.brief_summary: PanDWM 将六路车载相机拼接为单一 360° 全景带，用逐窗口四步因果学生模型（由教师蒸馏并在自采样轨迹上训练）生成视频，并用前馈解码器沿相机射线提升为 3D 高斯以构成 4D 驾驶场景。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属驾驶场景视频与 4D 场景生成，核心是多视角一致性与渲染效率，未涉及 VLM 推理中的 latent 状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，缺乏可用于 LVR 的具体借鉴线索。
